name: refund-dispute-handler
description: Handles a refund request or a dispute (chargeback) against your own payments account: given a customer, a charge or dispute id, or a pasted customer email, it reads the charge, the customer's plan, invoices, prior refunds and disputes, and your email with them, applies the refund policy in code (14-day window, auto-approve up to 100.00, prorated annual plans by default, or your organization's refund policy) and returns an approve / partial / deny / needs-human recommendation with the reasons and evidence. For a dispute it gives the deadline, an evidence checklist and a packet to paste. It drafts the reply to the customer and sends it only after you approve that exact text. It never issues a refund, submits dispute evidence or closes a dispute: you do that in your payments dashboard.

skills.name: Refund and dispute handling
